voiceIntro: Tap the microphone at the bottom of the screen and say, for example:

tips_.swipe: On a phone, swipe left or right to move from one screen to the next.
tips_.rolling: On a phone, days follow one another starting today: scroll down to see more, “Previous days” to go back.
tips_.defaultPresence: No need to fill everything in: without a report, everyone is counted according to their usual presence.
tips_.noAccount: Your guests need neither an account nor an app: the link is enough.
tips_.conflicts: When you suggest a date, the app warns you if it clashes with a calendar event or a date already suggested elsewhere.
tips_.voiceButton: The microphone button lets you add an absence, a dish, a guest or shopping without typing.
tips_.fromMeals: Ingredients added from a dish (“+ Ingredients”) land here directly, with the name of the dish.
tips_.live: The list is shared live: what one person ticks off in the shop disappears for everyone else.
tips_.reminders: A task with a due date becomes urgent on that date, and the person in charge gets a reminder every day until it is done.
tips_.proposals: Dates suggested for a meal to organise appear with a dashed outline: tap them to open the meal.
tips_.adminOnly: This screen is reserved for family administrators.

presence.title: Presence
presence.intro: Who is home for lunch, dinner and the night. Everyone only reports what differs from usual, and the app works out how many place settings are needed, guests included.

absence.q: Report that I won't be there
absence.a: Tap “Declare” on the day, choose “Absence”, then the meals (lunch, dinner) and the night. The others see it straight away.

longAbsence.q: Going away for several days (holidays, course…)
longAbsence.a: “Declare” then “Long absence”: enter the first and last day, and from which meal you leave and come back. No need to report each day.

guest.a: Tap “+ Guest” on the meal, enter the name and the number of people (a couple = 2). Guests count in the place settings.

usual.a: Open “My usual presence”: say whether you are usually home or away, day by day, for lunch, dinner and the night. Then you only report the exceptions.

alternate.a: In “My usual presence”, turn on “Alternate every other week” and fill in week A and week B. The app knows which week is current.

voice.absent: Paul won't be here for lunch tomorrow
voice.present: I'll be there on Saturday evening
voice.guest: Grandma and Grandpa are coming for lunch on Sunday

meals.title: Meals
meals.intro: This week's menus, lunch and dinner, with the number of people at the table for each meal.

dish.a: Tap “Add a dish” on lunch or dinner. If your family uses Mealie, you can search for a recipe directly.

ingredients.q: Add the ingredients to the shopping list
ingredients.a: On the dish, tap “+ Ingredients” and tick what needs buying: it all goes to the shared shopping list.

headcount.a: The number shown on each meal counts the members at home and the guests. Tap it to see who is there, who is away, and to correct it.

guests.a: In the meal details, enter the guest's name and the number of people, then “Invite”. The − / + buttons change the number afterwards.

voice.menu: What are we eating this week?

mealPlans.title: Gathering to organise
mealPlans.intro: To find a date with guests, like a poll: you suggest dates, everyone votes from a link, then you set the date.

create.a: “New meal”: give it a title, choose lunch or dinner, add the guests (with the number of people) and tap the possible dates in the calendar.

share.q: Send the link to the guests
share.a: Tap “Send on WhatsApp” or copy the link. Each guest ticks the dates when they are available.

follow.a: The grid shows who is available on each date and how many people in total. You get a notification for each vote.

close.a: Tap “Set the date” and choose the date: the guests can be added to the meal and an event created in the calendar. Guests see the chosen date on the link.

reopen.a: “Reopen the vote” cancels the chosen date: the guests and the event created are removed, and voting resumes.

general.title: Welcome to FamilyGest
general.intro: Everything that keeps the home running, shared between all family members.

navigate.a: The menu gives access to presence, meals, shopping, tasks and the calendar. The dashboard sums up the day.

family.a: If you belong to several families, pick one from your avatar menu at the top right.

profile.a: Avatar at the top right › My profile: choose the alerts you receive (on the phone or by email) and the daily summary.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: The day at a glance: who is home, what we're eating, urgent shopping, tasks and upcoming events.

today.q: See the day at a glance
today.a: The top cards show how many will be at the table for lunch and dinner, who sleeps at home, and what is on the menu.

cards.a: Tap a card or “See all” to open the matching screen: presence, meals, shopping, tasks or calendar.

whatsnew.a: When a new version brings new features, a “What's new?” window presents them once on each device.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.intro: A single list for the whole family, sorted by aisle and updated live.

add.a: Type the name in the field at the top, choose the aisle and quantity if needed, then confirm.

check.a: In the shop, tap an item to tick it: it moves to “Already in the cart”. Tap it again to untick it.

urgent.a: Tick “Urgent” when adding (or editing) it: it is highlighted and counted on the dashboard.

categories.q: Change the order of the aisles
categories.a: An administrator can create and reorder aisles in Settings › Shopping categories, to follow the route through the shop.

voice.add: Add milk and eggs to the shopping

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.intro: Things to do around the house, shared out between family members.

create.a: “Add a task”: give it a title, assign it to a member, choose the category and priority.

done.a: Tap the box next to the task. Tap it again to set it back to do.

due.a: Enter a due date: on that day the task becomes urgent and the person in charge gets a reminder every day.

private.a: Tick “Private task” when creating or editing a task: it is assigned to you and only you can see it. Other members, Alexa and the assistant connector can't see it, and nobody is notified.

filter.a: The filters at the top show tasks to do or done, for everyone or for one member.

voice.member: What tasks does Paul have to do?

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: The family's shared calendar: appointments, outings, holidays, birthdays.

create.a: Tap a day then “+ Add”: title, time (or all day), members involved.

multiDay.a: In the form, enter an end date: holidays, a course or a weekend appear on each day.

recurring.a: Choose a frequency (daily, weekly, monthly) and an end date: all the dates are created at once.

absence.a: Tick “Create an absence”: the members involved are counted as away during the event, with nothing else to report.

sync.a: After saving, add the event to Google Calendar or download it for Apple Calendar / Outlook (.ics).

voice.add: Add a dentist appointment on Tuesday at 3 pm
voice.holidays: We're going on holiday from 20 to 27 October

settings.title: Family settings
settings.intro: Managing the family: members, invitations, shopping aisles and connected services.

invite.a: In “Member management”, invite someone by email: they receive a link to create their account and join the family.

members.a: Tap a member to change their role, administrator rights or usual presence.

categories.a: “Shopping categories”: add aisles and change their order to match your shop.

connectors.a: Each service has its own section: follow the step-by-step guide. The secret link created must only be shared with trusted people.

export.a: “Data backup and export” downloads all the family's data in a file.

infos.usualPresence: This is your “default” presence. Unless you report otherwise, you are counted according to this setting; then you only report the exceptions.
infos.slots: Lunch and dinner count the place settings; the night shows who sleeps at home.
infos.guestCount: One line can count several people: a couple = 2, a family of four = 4. Everyone is counted in the place settings.
infos.generateAbsence: The ticked members are counted as away for meals (and the night) during the event. If the event dates change, their absences follow.
infos.urgent: An urgent item is highlighted in the list and counted on everyone's dashboard.

mealPlans.title: No gathering to organise
mealPlans.text: Want to invite friends or family? Suggest several dates: they vote from a simple WhatsApp link, without installing anything, and you set the date.

tasks.title: No tasks yet
tasks.text: Share out what needs doing at home: each task has someone in charge and, if needed, a due date with a reminder.

shopping.title: Nothing to buy for now
shopping.text: Add an item in the field above, or from a dish with “+ Ingredients”. The whole family sees the list live.
